digest.component_or_area: tickets branch garbage collection and epoch enforcement
propositions: Execute a one-time deterministic reclaim of the tickets branch by force-push after full quiescence: all writers disabled, zero active sessions confirmed, all MCP servers stopped, and no in-flight Gerrit votes pending.

The epoch-blind writer risk must be closed by direct runtime proofs under quiescence (descendant workflow ancestry, live review-bot refusal probe, and refreshed host binary refusal probe) rather than elapsed time alone.

Verify non-resurrection and store integrity post-publication: old tip must not be an ancestor of origin/tickets, size-pack growth must be <1 MB, identity.enforce_since must be landed correctly, and fsck must be clean with only the four intentional STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED records.

Convergence and resumability constraints: the store is quiesced during the rewrite (no dual-write window), the force-push is atomic and not resumable, and rollback requires re-divergence of already-converged consumers; all correctness assertions run pre-publication on a scratch clone.

The landed identity.enforce_since key at rebar.toml:115 must equal the mapped post-rewrite SHA from the pre-window A6-0d pin; require_authenticated=false bypasses the enforce_since check in verify_authorship.py so no CI deadlock occurs.

Post-enable reconciliation must validate either a green reconcile-bridge.yml run or an operator-approved production-equivalent CLI sequence with zero mutation/recovery failures, all Jira batches successful, and canary drift_total=0.
